title: GTA6 Sleuths Divided on Whether Florida's Key West is in the Game
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans are currently divided on whether the famous Florida locale Key West will be featured in the game following the latest extended gameplay preview.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Sleuths Divided on Key West Inclusion

Grand Theft Auto fans are widely known for their passion for speculation and information sleuthing, and this behavior has certainly not slowed down since Rockstar released the extended gameplay preview for Grand Theft Auto 6. Following the latest media drops, the community's current fixation revolves around a specific geographic question: whether or not Key West will be featured in the game.

## Community Speculation Continues

According to reports from Eurogamer, fans examining the recent footage are completely torn. One camp of community sleuths is convinced that clues in the preview point directly to the inclusion of the famous Florida locale, while others remain skeptical, arguing that the scenery might represent a different coastal interpretation within the game's fictional setting rather than Key West itself. 

This intense level of frame-by-frame analysis highlights just how deeply invested the fanbase is in mapping out the scale and scope of Rockstar's upcoming open world.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to watch the community dissect every single second of official footage. While whether Key West is actually in the game remains unconfirmed speculation at this stage, this kind of dedicated sleuthing underscores the immense anticipation surrounding GTA6. We will have to wait for further official updates from Rockstar to know for sure.
